objective: Convert degree and radian measures, identify coterminal angles, and calculate an arc length with consistent units.
checkpointRule: Every question is critical and all four must be correct independently. A four-question form samples four families, not all 38 named variants.

conventions.referenceAngle: Strictly acute; axes have no acute reference angle.
conventions.principalAngle: Use the exact interval named in the question; zero is allowed in [0,2pi), while a least positive coterminal angle is 2pi for an axis at zero.
conventions.motion: Track signed net rotation separately from nonnegative total angular travel, arc distance and speed.
conventions.sector: Ordinary geometric sector area uses a nonnegative sweep no greater than a full turn. Repeatedly swept area and unique covered region are explicitly different.

activationRequirements: Complete original instruction and worked examples
Exact conversion and terminal-ray grading, including ordinary radians
Guided practice and a radius/angle investigation
All named practice variants and mixed critical checkpoints
Coverage, retrieval, accessibility, mobile, keyboard and persistence verification
